# Fixtures

VTC-006 provides no seed account, company configuration or domain data. The local MySQL volume starts with an empty application database. Structural browser fixtures remain in [the reviewed API examples](../../docs/contracts/dashboard/examples.json); telemetry fixtures remain in [their separate directory](../../docs/contracts/examples/README.md). They are not a database seed or valid credentials.

VTC-007 supplies [synthetic persistence fixtures](persistence/) separately from shipped migrations: a committed prior-schema migration, parent/value tables, a deliberately failing partial-DDL migration and a bounded slow-statement timeout migration. The guarded `pnpm db:test` and `pnpm db:recovery` commands reset only explicit fixture/audit/journal tables in a disposable `vtc_test_*` schema, requiring the launcher allocation, suite-lock owner, canonical baseline, `NODE_ENV=test` and `DB_TEST_RESET_ACK=synthetic-only`; see the [instructions and limits](../../docs/development/persistence.md#explicit-synthetic-verification). Database-independent half-open protocol peers live under `test/scaffold/` and never connect to a configured database. There is no automatic production seed or real account, and fixture numbers are not company settings.

VTC-008 supplies [test-only fresh builders and doubles](../support/) and [the isolated runner](../../docs/development/testing.md). Canonical telemetry examples are read directly without edits or a competing copy. The clock/UUID/member builders return independent state; values are synthetic and do not establish company configuration. The identity credential is deliberately nonfunctional; no real password hash, provider identity or active token is used. Feature owners retain domain/workflow fixtures. Never import real users, reports, source archives, private screenshots or hosting diagnostics to make local development work.

VTC-012's [foundation mocks](../../apps/web/src/features/foundation/mocks.ts) use generated browser DTOs and preserve the provenance of the reviewed listTrips empty/error-403, catalog English-fallback and company analytics examples. Long-name and partial-distance presentation variants are explicitly fictional. Unit tests validate responses against the generated runtime schemas. Synthetic UI routes never intercept real readiness, seed a database or grant access. Supplemental controlled browser failures are separately named; the real MySQL smoke is retained. Synthetic success screenshots stay ignored under .local/testing/ for rendered review, without broader CI artifact uploads.


VTC-025 adds original generated image pixels in `manual-images.ts` and frozen pre-VTC-025 facts/table-model fixtures from commit `2b5d9fc452b80bbc831c6340f5330b9783dc5f67`. Only fixture imports are relocated. They exercise legacy-column writes/readback and old-reader version rejection against actual MySQL; they are not a full old production image. No game assets or member screenshots are redistributed.
